observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment projection-coherence history and immutable pass evidence

outcome.limitation: Four recorded ambient projection passes each reported 10 pending outputs and zero reconciliations. The latest immutable pass classified all 10 results as deferred because the structure-verdict provider was unbound; its diagnostic names mncs-doctor:projection-health.
outcome.evidence_interpretation: This is a recurring same-session service deferral and an actionable provider-discovery/binding investigation. The pass summaries for the three older records preserve counts but not their per-projection diagnostics, so the exact gate reason is established for the latest record only.
outcome.next_investigation: Determine why the read-only Doctor projection-health provider is not available to the Environment projection service, while preserving checkout boundaries and preventing read-provider discovery from widening write authority.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient projection refresh repeatedly deferred work while the Doctor health provider was unbound
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment projection coherence and Doctor provider binding
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Trace declared read-only provider dependencies through workspace selection, session binding, and ambient projection execution; make required providers available through existing contracts without granting write access to their repositories.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The four records belong to one campaign session, not four independent sessions.
Only the latest pass preserves the exact per-projection gate diagnostics in this readback; older passes establish repeated pending and reconciliation counts only.
The derived 39.589-second sum adds recorded ambient-pass elapsed values; it is not isolated projection CPU time or measured agent intervention.

A deferred projection may be a safe coordination outcome. The evidence identifies a provider-unbound condition but does not establish why the provider was unavailable or that the projection content was unsafe to refresh.
No remediation has been made and no effectiveness claim is established.
